result.summary: Both N slots pass at novelty 3 / soundness 3, and all five R groups pass at soundness 3. In slot a (tails and skew of the intraday volume centroid) seed 9 is struck. It has liq/known |ρ| of 0.46/0.45, and its Pearson index-volume correlation is a §4-3 liquidity risk. In slot b (auction participation shares) three seeds are struck. Seed 2 is a liquidity/known proxy at 0.57/0.60. Seed 6 fails the gate with coverage 0.69, because a zero opening auction gives div by 0 = inf and log(inf) = inf, which cross_mean carries forward. Seed 10 is seed 2 with a flat-ratio key and stays at 0.43/0.47. Open risks in slot b: k correlates with size at 0.43–0.48 and no seed buckets it by size; the change versions move the 2018-08-20 SSE reform jump instead of removing it; and the o means are dominated by limit-lock days. In R1, switching to Volume brings in a split / bonus-share (送转) ex-date jump that Amt did not have. That jump also confounds the variant 3 versus variant 4 decomposition. In R3 the correlation table weakens the zero-mass premise: zero_ratio vs the kurt head is below 0.27, and variant 1 vs the head is 0.89. R3 variant 2 is gate-failed (distinct 0.054).
